description: Angular component for managing device credentials using LWM2M security configurations in the Thingsboard platform.

classes.name: DeviceCredentialsLwm2mComponent
classes.description: Angular component implementing ControlValueAccessor and Validator for LWM2M device credentials configuration.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Parses and initializes the form with the provided JSON string.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers a callback function to propagate form value changes.

methods.name: registerOnTouched
methods.description: Method placeholder for registering touch callback (not implemented).

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Enables or disables the form controls based on the input boolean.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the form group and returns validation errors if invalid.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up subscriptions on component destruction.

methods.name: rebootDevice
methods.description: Triggers a device reboot via the DeviceService and shows notification based on response.

methods.name: initClientSecurityConfig
methods.description: Initializes form with security configuration data.

methods.name: securityConfigClientModeChanged
methods.description: Handles changes in security mode and updates form accordingly.

methods.name: securityConfigClientUpdateValidators
methods.description: Updates validators for client security fields based on selected security mode.

methods.name: setValidatorsNoSecX509
methods.description: Clears validators and disables client identity and key fields.

methods.name: setValidatorsPskRpk
methods.description: Sets validators for PSK or RPK security modes.

methods.name: initLwm2mConfigForm
methods.description: Creates and initializes the reactive form group with controls and subscriptions.
